skills.summary: First-pass exploration of an unknown dataset
skills.job: Profile a new dataset, find its shape, distributions and relationships, and list questions worth asking.
triggers: give me a first look at this file
gotchas: drawing conclusions from the first pattern
ignoring how the data was collected

skills.summary: Score a dataset for quality problems
skills.job: Check completeness, validity, uniqueness, consistency and freshness, and report problems with counts.
triggers: check the quality of this data
audit this export before we use it
gotchas: rules not agreed with the owner

skills.summary: Find and judge unusual values
skills.job: Flag outliers with more than one method and decide with context whether each is an error, rare or real.
triggers: why is the average so high
gotchas: treating a data entry error like a real extreme

skills.summary: Pick the right chart for the question
skills.job: Choose a chart type from the question and data shape, and specify axes, order, labels and what to avoid.
triggers: how do I show this comparison
my chart is hard to read

skills.summary: Read the result of an A/B test
skills.job: Check design validity, then read lift, uncertainty and guardrail metrics, and state a decision with caveats.

skills.summary: Build and read cohort retention tables
skills.job: Group users by start period, build a retention or revenue cohort table and read it correctly.
triggers: how does retention change by signup month
gotchas: incomplete latest periods read as drops
cohort size too small to read

skills.summary: Measure drop-off between funnel steps
skills.job: Define ordered steps, compute conversion and drop-off, and find where and for whom it leaks.
gotchas: steps not in a strict order

skills.summary: Fit and interpret a simple regression
skills.job: Fit a linear or logistic regression, check assumptions and explain coefficients in plain words.
triggers: run a regression on this data

skills.summary: Separate trend, season and noise
skills.job: Decompose a time series, read trend and seasonality and compare periods fairly.
triggers: show the seasonality in this data
compare this month to last year

skills.summary: Analyse survey responses with care
skills.job: Clean survey data, handle scales and open text, weight where needed and report with sample sizes.
triggers: what do the free-text answers say

skills.summary: Match and merge duplicate records
skills.job: Find duplicate or near-duplicate records across sources, choose survivors and merge with an audit trail.
triggers: find records that are the same person

skills.summary: Plan a sample and its size
skills.job: Choose a sampling method and size for a question, with the bias risks and the margin of error stated.
triggers: how many responses do I need
gotchas: size computed for the wrong subgroup

skills.summary: Define a metric so it can be computed
skills.job: Write an exact definition of a metric: numerator, denominator, window, filters, grain and edge cases.
triggers: we disagree on what churn means
gotchas: ratio of sums versus mean of ratios

skills.summary: Specify a dashboard before building it
skills.job: Write a dashboard spec: audience, decisions, metrics, filters, layout and refresh, before any tool is opened.
triggers: what should be on our KPI dashboard

skills.summary: Make a simple forecast with a range
skills.job: Build a baseline forecast, test it on held-out periods and report a range with assumptions.
triggers: forecast next quarter from this data
gotchas: fitting on all data then testing on it

skills.summary: Check keys before joining tables
skills.job: Test uniqueness, coverage and type of join keys, and predict row counts before running a join.
triggers: will these two tables join cleanly
gotchas: keys differing in case or padding
inner join dropping unmatched rows silently

skills.summary: Handle missing values with a stated rule
skills.job: Diagnose why values are missing and choose to drop, flag or fill, with the effect on results shown.
triggers: what do I do with the blanks

skills.summary: Explain a statistic in plain words
skills.job: Explain a statistical idea or result to a non-specialist with a concrete example and its limits.
gotchas: no example from the user's data
false certainty in the plain version

skills.summary: Write a data dictionary for a dataset
skills.job: Document each field with meaning, type, units, allowed values, source and known quirks.

skills.summary: Write up analysis findings for a reader
skills.job: Turn analysis results into a short report: answer, evidence, caveats and a recommendation.
triggers: summarise the analysis for my manager
turn these numbers into a report
